terms.definition: A chart connecting data points with lines to show change over time.
terms.function: Makes trends visible at a glance.
terms.whereItIs: The connected path on the chart plate.
terms.whyItMatters: Line graphs are how we watch things change.

terms.definition: One measured value plotted at a specific time.
terms.function: The building block the line connects.
terms.whereItIs: Each round dot on the path.
terms.whyItMatters: Every line is built from these individual points.

terms.definition: The overall direction of change shown by the line.
terms.function: Up = rising, down = falling, flat = steady.
terms.whereItIs: The slope of the path across time.
terms.whyItMatters: Reading the trend is the whole point of the graph.

terms.definition: The horizontal axis carrying time from left to right.
terms.function: Orders the data points in sequence.
terms.whyItMatters: Left-to-right order is what makes a line graph a story.
